narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of Exodus; here only introduces the Lord's words

the-lord.name: The Lord
the-lord.note: God speaking to Moses on Sinai, giving measured, solemn instructions for the tabernacle, vestments and priesthood

1.t: Thou shalt make also an altar to burn incense, of setim wood.

2.t: It shall be a cubit in length, and another in breadth, that is, four square, and two in height. Horns shall go out of the same.

3.t: And thou shalt overlay it with the purest gold, as well the grate thereof, as the walls round about, and the horns. And thou shalt make to it a crown of gold round about,

4.t: And two golden rings under the crown on either side, that the bars may be put into them, and the altar be carried.

5.t: And thou shalt make the bars also of setim wood, and shalt overlay them with gold.

6.t: And thou shalt set the altar over against the veil, that hangeth before the ark of the testimony before the propitiatory wherewith the testimony is covered, where I will speak to thee.

7.t: And Aaron shall burn sweet smelling incense upon it in the morning. When he shall dress the lamps, he shall burn it:

8.t: And when he shall place them in the evening, he shall burn an everlasting incense before the Lord throughout your generations.

9.t: You shall not offer upon it incense of another composition, nor oblation, and victim, neither shall you offer libations.

10.t: And Aaron shall pray upon the horns thereof once a year, with the blood of that which was offered for sin; and shall make atonement upon it in your generations. It shall be most holy to the Lord.

11.t: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:

12.t: When thou shalt take the sum of the children of Israel, according to their number, every one of them shall give a price for their souls to the Lord, and there shall be no scourge among them, when they shall be reckoned.

13.t: And this shall every one give that passeth at the naming, half a sicle according to the standard of the temple. A sicle hath twenty obols. Half a sicle shall be offered to the Lord.

14.t: He that is counted in the number from twenty years and upwards, shall give the price.

15.t: The rich man shall not add to half a sicle, and the poor man shall diminish nothing.

16.t: And the money received, which was contributed by the children of Israel, thou shalt deliver unto the uses of the tabernacle of the testimony, that it may be a memorial of them before the Lord, and he may be merciful to their souls.

17.t: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:

18.t: Thou shalt make also a brazen laver with its foot to wash in: and thou shalt set it between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar. And water being put into it:

19.t: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and feet in it:

20.t: When they are going into the tabernacle of the testimony, and when they are to come to the altar, to offer on it incense to the Lord,

21.t: Lest perhaps they die. It shall be an everlasting law to him, and to his seed by successions.

22.t: And the Lord spoke to Moses,

23.t: Take spices, of principal and chosen myrrh five hundred sicles, and of cinnamon half so much; that is, two hundred and fifty sicles, of calamus in like manner two hundred and fifty,

24.t: And of cassia five hundred sicles by the weight of the sanctuary, of oil of olives the measure hin:

25.t: And thou shalt make the holy oil of unction, an ointment compounded after the art of the perfumer,

26.t: And therewith thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the testimony, and the ark of the testament,

27.t: And the table with the vessels thereof, the candlestick and furniture thereof, the altars of incense,

28.t: And of holocaust, and all the furniture that belongeth to the service of them.

29.t: And thou shalt sanctify all, and they shall be most holy: he that shall touch them shall be sanctified.

30.t: Thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and shalt sanctify them, that they may do the office of priesthood unto me.

31.t: And thou shalt say to the children of Israel: This oil of unction shall be holy unto me throughout your generations.

32.t: The flesh of man shall not be anointed therewith, and you shall make none other of the same composition, because it is sanctified, and shall be holy unto you.

33.t: What man soever shall compound such, and shall give thereof to a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.

34.t: And the Lord said to Moses:
Take unto thee spices, stacte, and onycha, galbanum of sweet savour, and the clearest frankincense, all shall be of equal weight.

35.t: And thou shalt make incense compounded by the work of the perfumer, well tempered together, and pure, and most worthy of sanctification.

36.t: And when thou hast beaten all into very small powder, thou shalt set of it before the tabernacle of the testimony, in the place where I will appear to thee. Most holy shall this incense be unto you.

37.t: You shall not make such a composition for your own uses, because it is holy to the Lord.

38.t: What man soever shall make the like, to enjoy the smell thereof, he shall perish out of his people.
